page_title: LAZ 2-0 LEC | Lazio v Lecce 23/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.
90+8' Nikola Stulic (Lecce) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
90+5' 2 - 0 An unlucky rebound falls to Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) and he scores with a bullet header.

90+5' Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the right side of the goal, but Wladimiro Falcone is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.
90+3' Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) was too forceful with his tackle and Alberto Arena interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
90+1' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
90+1' Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, Lecce are going to take it.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
90' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Wladimiro Falcone has no trouble gathering it.
89' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mario Gila leaves the pitch and Patric (Lazio) comes on.
87' Maurizio Sarri has decided to make a change. Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) replaces Boulaye Dia.
85' Toma Basic (Lazio) picks up a pass and fires a powerful long-range shot which goes painfully close to the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
84' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) commits a rough challenge and Alberto Arena blows his whistle for an infringement.
82' Maurizio Sarri prepares a substitution. Gustav Isaksen is replaced by Pedro (Lazio).
82' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Konan Ndri (Lecce) is given a yellow card.
81' Lameck Banda (Lecce) fails to get a shot on target, as the well positioned defensive wall comfortably deals with his free kick.
79' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Alberto Arena didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
76' Tete Morente will be replaced by Konan Ndri (Lecce).
76' Eusebio Di Francesco decides to make a substitution. Lassana Coulibaly will be replaced by Mohamed Kaba (Lecce).
75' The referee signals a substitution. Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) is brought on as a substitute for Luca Pellegrini.
72' Matias Vecino (Lazio) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
72' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) misses a great chance to score after his effort hits the left post!
71' A loose pass is instantly latched onto by Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio). He tries his luck from the edge of the box with a measured shot, but it hits the right post and is cleared to safety.
69' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.

67' A rebound falls to Tiago Gabriel (Lecce) who knows what to do with it. He drills a low shot from the edge of the penalty box, but Ivan Provedel anticipates his intention and denies him with a nice quick save.

65' A clever short pass gives Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
63' Riccardo Sottil comes off the pitch to be replaced by Santiago Pierotti (Lecce).
63' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
62' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
62' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
61' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) takes the corner which is cleared.
60' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. It will be a corner kick for Lazio.
59' The resulting corner from Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) is cleared.

58' Mattia Zaccagni plays a short pass through to Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) inside the box, but he scuffs his effort well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
56' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
56' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and sends a shot to the right side of the goal, but is denied by a reflex save from Wladimiro Falcone.
55' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
55' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Lazio.
54' The goal by Lazio is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to a foul.
52' Wait! Referee Alberto Arena has indicated he is going to review the Lazio goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a foul in the build-up.
50' Goal! A mistake from the defence gifted a chance to a lurking Boulaye Dia (Lazio), who keeps his cool and rolls the ball into the net from close range. 2:0.
50' It looks like Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) saw red with that tackle. Alberto Arena won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
47' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Eusebio Di Francesco probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Francesco Camarda (Lecce). He is replaced by Nikola Stulic.
46' Eusebio Di Francesco has made a change at the break. Lameck Banda has come on in place of Medon Berisha (Lecce).
46' Half-time substitution. Maurizio Sarri decided to make a change. Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) is replaced by Matias Vecino.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Adam Marusic (Lazio) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.

42' The ball spins to Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) on the edge of the box. He hits across the ball and sends it goalwards, but it goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
41' Adam Marusic (Lazio) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
40' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender.
39' Toma Basic (Lazio) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
37' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
35' That's unlucky! Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
32' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.

29' 1 - 0 Toma Basic looks around to decide who he is going to pass to. He picks out Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio), who collects the ball perfectly and unleashes a terrific shot from just outside of the box towards the bottom left corner and it ricochets in off the post. The score is 1:0.
26' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom left corner, but Wladimiro Falcone pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
25' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
22' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
19' Toma Basic (Lazio) fires a powerful shot which is blocked.

16' A fine solo run by Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) takes him deep into the box, but it comes to nothing as his shot flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
16' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Adam Marusic (Lazio), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
15' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) decides to speed play up by quickly sending the free kick into the box.
14' It's going to be a corner kick.
14' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. The ball goes out of play. Lazio are awarded a corner kick.
13' Toma Basic (Lazio) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
12' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Alberto Arena blows for a foul.
9' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) attempts a lovely volley towards the bottom right corner of the net, but it's saved by the keeper.
8' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
6' The ball is in the net but it’s immediately ruled out by referee Alberto Arena due to a foul, much to the disappointment of the Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) and his team.
3' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Boulaye Dia (Lazio), but the defence gets it clear.
